name: Per E Kummervold
bio: Per E Kummervold is one of the most active contributors to NB AI-Lab's open source work on GitHub, with 4,158 contributions to nb-whisper, nostram. Their public GitHub profile reads: “Per Egil Kummervold, PhD, is a Reasearch Professor at the National Library of Norway. Main research area is language adaptation in LLMs”.
